features_new_in_3_0.what: Automatic Flash-Next rowwise-FP8 dense format on SM120 plus matching small-batch kernels
features_new_in_3_0.why: reduces weight traffic per token; removes copied benchmark flags from ordinary startup
features_new_in_3_0.scope_note: online FP8 itself predates 3.0; the representation, default selection, and companion kernels are new

features_new_in_3_0.what: Dense projections and target/draft output heads use specialized small-batch GPU kernels reading resident FP8 weights directly
features_new_in_3_0.why: avoids repeated conversion/materialization of weights on hot small ops; larger/unsupported shapes retain established paths

features_new_in_3_0.what: HyperConnection HCMIX2 branch normalization/mixing uses dedicated kernels
features_new_in_3_0.why: removes serialization in the previous persistent mix

features_new_in_3_0.what: GDN gated normalization fused with output projection
features_new_in_3_0.why: removes an intermediate operation and memory pass
features_new_in_3_0.disambiguation: distinct from the packaged FlashInfer GDN FP16-accumulate MMA (flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#6227); different changes

features_new_in_3_0.what: Native MTP BF16 entry projection and single-token NVFP4 draft MoE kernels
features_new_in_3_0.why: speeds the small operations repeated for each draft token

features_new_in_3_0.what: Packed-key softmax expert router combines scoring/selection
features_new_in_3_0.why: faster routing without changing experts or weights

features_new_in_3_0.what: Adaptive width at C1 only: W4/W8 by acceptance; C2+ fixed W4 using padded graph batch size. FR-Spec remains enabled at all concurrency levels; one draft model.
features_new_in_3_0.why: wider speculation where acceptance makes it worthwhile; safer width switching via QSA pending keyring, per-width graph state/selection, target autotuning

features_new_in_3_0.what: Avoid constructing the discarded FlashInfer backend when QSA immediately replaces it; share QSA decode scratch where execution lifetime permits
features_new_in_3_0.why: frees VRAM so the adaptive default is affordable and the token pool can grow; see vram_measured_stages

features_new_in_3_0.what: Actual speculative Mamba state buffer reservation, context headroom (PR 27), and committed-token checkpoint boundaries (upstream 43029)
features_new_in_3_0.why: speculative proposals cannot determine retained state

features_new_in_3_0.what: Retain resumable checkpoints, evict redundant interior states preferentially, release abandoned branch ownership, protect shared backups per owner
features_new_in_3_0.why: resumable sessions; benefit requires client session IDs and closure

features_new_in_3_0.what: FP32 GDN gating beta during extend/prefill
features_new_in_3_0.why: avoids avoidable BF16 rounding in recurrent updates

features_new_in_3_0.what: Literal thinking tags after reasoning remain answer text; Responses emits required reasoning-part lifecycle and correct capped/failed terminal status

features_new_in_3_0.why: exposes parse failures without logging private prompts/arguments

features_new_in_3_0.what: Lost image SHM rejects the affected request and releases GPU feature buffers
features_new_in_3_0.why: keeps scheduler and other requests running; underlying early-unlink cause still investigated

features_new_in_3_0.what: Operator-owned run/startup/config files outside the container; read-only /config mount; model/cache mounts separate; edit and restart or update image without rebuilding
features_new_in_3_0.why: simpler setup; NIXL optional and on by default, independent of GPU/RAM cache and PLE

features_new_in_3_0.what: Optional beta configurator creates timestamped ordinary launch files, preserves earlier files, resolves settings consistently, stages saves
features_new_in_3_0.why: avoids partial writes and clobbered launch files; carried forward without the old perf stack

features_new_in_3_0.what: FlashInfer 0.7.0 post1 split CUDA 13 providers; accepted SM120 MoE/GDN sources packaged into installs; ordinary upgrades install matching providers
features_new_in_3_0.why: reliable installs/upgrades; interrupted extension builds recover (PR 31); build failures retain useful compiler diagnostics

features_new_in_3_0.what: Persistent cache identity distinguishes effective FP8 representation/GDN mode; WSL2 host-memory aliases and hybrid NIXL component keys corrected
Retain RTX Blackwell for RTX PRO 6000 inference and Ampere/Ada Lovelace for image-processing sidecars; trim other GPU build targets.
